verses.2: May those who are wise be delivered from harm on that day. May Jehovah save them.
verses.3: May the LORD protect it and keep it alive. May it thrive in this land, and may its enemies not be able to take it away from it.
verses.4: YHWH will make us suffer on the cross, where every one of them was turned into a sacrifice.
verses.5: I have said, “Lord, please heal my soul, for I have sinned against You.”
verses.6: Oh, they said that it was bad for me. His name has been forgotten and lost.
verses.7: And if he comes to see, and his heart wants to speak, then he will leave and go away. He won’t be able to speak anymore.
verses.8: All those who hate me will speak evil of me. They will think badly of me.
verses.9: The words of Bliyal rushed into him, and he lay there, unable to get up.
verses.10: Even a man who is honest and trustworthy, if I trust him, will also increase my food supply.
verses.11: And you, LORD, will protect me and help me. May you also destroy them.
verses.12: In this, I knew that you wanted me, because you wouldn’t let my enemies harm me.
verses.13: And I, in my humility, will be placed before you forever.
verses.14: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from this world to the next. Amen.
